prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find object, if visible then approach, if not then scan. Take object, process it, move to destination and perform task.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <BehaviorTree ID = MobileRobotTask>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = TakeObject    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />         <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />         <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    />         <Action ID = PerformSpecificTask    />     </Sequence>     <Fallback>         <Sequence>             <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />             <Action ID = ApproachObject    />         </Sequence>         <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />     </Fallback> </BehaviorTree>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO PerformSpecificTask
	END
